module: Flowgraph node "Rally Mode Create Ground Marker Route" (category once_instant, tag rally). Creates the ground marker route (core_groundMarkers.setPath) to a named position of a pathData: the sorted pathnodes (if includePathnodes, true by default) then the named start position, moved back by routeEndOffsetMeters (10 m by default) along its local -Y axis and projected onto the terrain. Waypoints less than 1 m from the previous one are ignored. Then triggers the onCreatedRallyGroundMarkerRoute hook. Inputs: pathData, name, includePathnodes, routeEndOffsetMeters.
notes: If pathData is absent or the named position cannot be found, a warning is logged and nothing is created.
The ground projection uses core_terrain.getTerrainHeight, otherwise a 150 m static raycast from 50 m above.

workOnce.desc: Builds the waypoint list, calls core_groundMarkers.setPath then extensions.hook('onCreatedRallyGroundMarkerRoute').
